3703-7084-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sporemound triggers, creating a 1/1 green Saproling creature token
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat from step 3.

Repeat.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.

Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2440-3399-4268-4399.description:
Cast Stormfront Riders by paying {4}{W/P} due to Defiler of Faith.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Mana Echoes and Kor Celebrant triggers.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Resolve the Kor Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders spell. When it enters, it, Mana Echoes and Kor Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Kor Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders trigger, returning it and the Soldier token created in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Stormfront Riders' second ability triggers twice.
Resolve a Stormfront Riders trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 one additional time.
Repeat from step 10 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger from step 6, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Repeat.

5344-6349-7042.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell from anywhere but your hand this turn.
5344-6349-7042.description:
Cast Appa by paying its mana cost.
When Appa enters, it triggers, exiling Charismatic Conqueror.
Cast Charismatic Conqueror from exile by paying {2}.
Charismatic Conqueror's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it.
Resolve the opponent's copy of Charismatic Conqueror, and then resolve your copy of Charismatic Conqueror.
When your Charismatic Conqueror token enters the battlefield,  the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to tap your Charismatic Conqueror token.
Resolve the original Charismatic Conqueror spell.
When the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the opponent's Vampire token enters the battlefield, both Charismatic Conquerors you control trigger, causing you to create at least one 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When your Vampire token enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the Vampire token, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Repeat from step 9.

Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
